shorts_extract.hook: Why 'because I have to make copies' worked 93% of the time at CUNY's Xerox machine for 5 pages — and crashed to 24% for 20 pages.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Langer, Blank & Chanowitz (1978 JPSP): 2×3 Xerox queue field experiment (5 vs 20 pages × No Reason / Real Rush / Placebic 'make copies').
shorts_extract.twist: Why pop-science cuts Langer's table in half, Folkes (1985) boundary replications, and mindful vs mindless scripts.
